name: Port Number Reference
summary: Search common TCP/UDP port numbers — HTTP, SSH, mail, databases, and more.
description: Quick reference for well-known ports: 80/443 web, 22 SSH, 25/587 mail, 53 DNS, 3306 MySQL, 5432 PostgreSQL, and others. Search by port number or service name and copy with one click.

faqs.question: Are these the only ports for each service?
faqs.answer: No. These are common defaults. Production setups may use custom ports or reverse proxies.

faqs.question: Why is port 22 listed twice?
faqs.answer: SSH and SFTP both typically use TCP 22. The reference notes both use cases.

faqs.question: Can I search by service name?
faqs.answer: Yes. Try postgres, redis, https, or any keyword from the descriptions.
